scores.claim_text: Powertrain & electronics manufacturing facility in San Carlos, CA.
scores.M_check: EPA FRS query for 'Joby' in CA filtered to San Carlos.
scores.interpretation: Per calibration heuristic #1, EPA FRS only registers facilities with regulated emissions/waste streams. A 'powertrain and electronics engineering' facility (largely electronics assembly + bench testing) is plausibly below permit thresholds. Absence is not a reliable contradiction signal here.

scores.claim_text: 130,000 sq ft additive/subtractive manufacturing + aircraft assembly + flight test facilities in Marina, CA.
scores.M_check: EPA FRS query for 'Joby' in CA filtered to Marina.
scores.interpretation: Marina is an aerospace prototype assembly + flight test site. Per the calibration heuristic, aviation/aerospace TEST facilities and light-assembly sites are EXPECTED to be absent from FRS unless they cross permit thresholds (e.g., composites curing with large solvent emissions, paint shop). With no visible composites/paint operations disclosed at this location, absence is not a meaningful contradiction. Joby's airpark/runway use is also FAA-regulated — outside our M-source catalog.

scores.claim_text: Planned high-rate production facility on a 140-acre site in Dayton, Ohio.
scores.M_check: EPA FRS query for 'Joby' in OH (statewide).
scores.M_value: 1 facility found: 'JOBY AVIATION', 3571 CONCORDE DR, VANDALIA, OH 45377 (Montgomery County, near Dayton International Airport).
scores.interpretation: Stronger than the claim required. The recipe expected the planned site to be EMPTY in registries (calibration #3), but Joby has already secured an EPA-registered footprint in the Dayton metro (Vandalia, MOM County) — consistent with site identification + active build-out. Independent registry corroborates the Ohio production-site narrative.

scores.claim_text: Delta Air Lines is a partner and investor (Umbrella Agreement Oct 7, 2022).
scores.M_check: EDGAR fulltext search for 'Joby' restricted to Delta's CIK 0000027904 from 2022-01-01 through cutoff.
scores.M_value: 6 hits: Delta 8-K announcing partnership (Oct 13, 2022); Delta 2023 and 2024 DEF 14A; Delta FY2023 10-K (filed Feb 12, 2024).
scores.interpretation: Counterparty corroborates fully. Delta independently disclosed the relationship in its 8-K, two consecutive proxies, and its 10-K. This is the gold-standard pattern for a real US-listed strategic partnership.

scores.claim_text: Toyota is an investor and parts supplier (Parts Supply Agreement Feb 15, 2023).
scores.M_check: EDGAR fulltext for 'Joby' on Toyota's CIK 0001094517 from 2019; sanity-checked with 'Toyota' inside Joby's own filings.
scores.M_value: 1 hit on Toyota's CIK (20-F filed June 23, 2022, mentioning Joby). 36 hits on 'Toyota' in Joby's own filings (consistent recurring partnership disclosure).
scores.interpretation: Per calibration heuristic #2, foreign-issuer ADR disclosure threshold is low (0-2 mentions of investee is normal). 1 mention in Toyota's 20-F is consistent with normal foreign-filer practice for a strategic but immaterial investee. Joby's own filings extensively cite Toyota (36 mentions), reflecting two real disclosed agreements (Aug 2019 collaboration + Feb 2023 parts supply).

scores.claim_text: DOD/USAF Agility Prime contracts >$131M potential through 2026; first aircraft delivered to DOD Sep 2023.
scores.M_check: EDGAR fulltext for distinctive program name 'Agility Prime' across all filers (external validation).
scores.M_value: 40 hits across multiple filings, primarily Joby's own 8-Ks and 10-Ks (2021-2023). Distinct program name is a real, traceable USAF program.
scores.interpretation: External-validation recipe: 40 hits is far above the >=10 PASS threshold. Multiple 8-Ks (2021-2023) consistently disclose contract expansions. The Sep 2023 delivery cannot be tested directly via M-sources (DOD acceptance isn't in EDGAR), but the program's reality and Joby's involvement are corroborated. Caveat: '$131M potential' is a ceiling, not committed revenue — real DOD contract value tends to be a fraction of OTA ceilings.

scores.claim_text: Long-running collaboration with Uber Technologies (Jan 2021 Collaboration Agreement + 2022 amendment).
scores.M_check: EDGAR fulltext for 'Joby' restricted to Uber's CIK 0001543151 from 2020.
scores.M_value: 13 hits on Uber's filings: Q4'20, Q3'21, Q2'23, Q3'23, Q4'23 earnings 8-Ks, Q2'23 and Q3'23 10-Qs, FY2023 10-K (Feb 2024 filing), and 2021 DEF 14A.
scores.interpretation: Strong counterparty disclosure across multiple years and filing types. Uber's 10-K, multiple 10-Qs, and earnings releases reference Joby — consistent with Uber's equity stake (received as consideration for Elevate divestiture) being recurring disclosure.

scores.claim_text: Proprietary IP across electric propulsion, motors, batteries, flight controls, and aircraft systems.
scores.M_check: USPTO ODP query on assignee 'Joby Aero' with categorize buckets: propulsion_motor, battery_power, flight_control, aircraft_structure.
scores.M_value: n_total_applications=329, n_granted=165 pre-cutoff. Category counts (granted+pending titles): propulsion_motor=68, battery_power=52, aircraft_structure=114, flight_control=1, other=94.
scores.interpretation: Strongly passes. 165 granted patents far exceeds the >=5 threshold; coverage is broad in the claimed areas (propulsion 68, battery 52, aircraft structure 114). The low flight_control bucket reflects keyword-string mismatch (most flight-control IP is titled with terms like 'fault-tolerant', 'actuator', 'autopilot' which CPC-tag flight control but use other keywords) rather than absence — the sample includes 'FAULT-TOLERANT VTOL AIRCRAFT WITH REDUNDANT CONTROL SURFACES AND ACTUATORS' and 'Dynamic Aircraft Routing'. This is the OPPOSITE of the Nikola pattern.
